title: Chapter 4: Globalization and Regionalism
content:
👋 ሰላም ውድ የEthioFresh ተማሪዎቻችን!

እንኳን ወደ Global Trends and International Relations የቱቶሪያል ክፍለ-ጊዜ በሰላም መጣችሁ! ዛሬ በሞጁላችሁ ውስጥ እጅግ በጣም ከፍተኛ የፈተና ክብደት ያላቸውንና ለፈተና 100% የሚመጡትን Section 4.6 (Defining Regionalism and Regional Integration)፣ 4.6.1 (The Old Regionalism) እና 4.6.2 (New Regionalism) በጥልቀትና በስፋት እናያለን። ይህን የቱቶሪያል ኖት በጥንቃቄ ካነበባችሁ በኋላ ተጨማሪ ምንም አይነት መጽሐፍ ወይም ኖት አያስፈልጋችሁም፤ በፈተናችሁ ላይ A+ ማስመዝገባችሁ የተረጋገጠ ነው! ዝግጁ ከሆናችሁ በጥሞና ተከታተሉ! 🚀

4.6. Defining Regionalism and Regional Integration

Theoretical Concepts & Definitions

1. Definition of Region:
According to Joseph Nye (1968), a region is defined as 'a limited number of states linked together by a geographical relationship and by a degree of mutual interdependence.' Geographical proximity alone is insufficient; there must exist a level of functional or political interdependence among the constituent units.

2. Definition of Regionalism:
Regionalism refers to intensifying political and/or economic processes of cooperation among states and other actors in particular geographic regions. As scholars emphasize, regionalism can be driven through two distinct approaches:

  • 'From below' (Bottom-up approach): Driven by market forces, business investment decisions by private corporations, and the movement of peoples across borders.
  • 'From above' (Top-down approach): Driven by political, state-based diplomatic efforts to create cohesive regional institutions, treaties, and common binding policies.
Regionalism embodies sustained formal or informal cooperation among governments, non-governmental organizations (NGOs), or the private sector across three or more countries for mutual gains (Allagappa 1994; Palmujoki 2001; Griffiths and O'Callaghan 2004).

3. Spatial Context and Categorization of Region (Buzan et al., 1998):
Barry Buzan and his colleagues categorized regions into distinct contextual levels:

  • Societal Context: The unit is the nation, and a region is defined as a set of adjacent nations sharing societal affinity.
  • Political Context: The unit is identified with the state, and a region means a spatially coherent territory composed of two or more states.
  • Sub-region: Refers to a subunit of a broader region involving more than one state (but fewer than all states in the region) or a transnational composition of parts of states.
  • Micro-region: Refers to subunit levels located within the internal sovereign boundaries of a single state.

4. Regionness, Regionalization vs. Regionalism:
Spatial proximity requires regionness or regional identity/awareness to become a dynamic driving force.

  • Regionalization: The growth of societal integration within a given region, encompassing undirected, informal processes of social and economic interaction among non-state and state units (Hurrell 1995a). It represents the dynamic, organic process of forming geopolitical units.
  • Regionalism: The deliberate political proneness and official policy of governments and peoples of two or more states to establish voluntary associations, pool material and non-material resources, share core norms and values, and establish institutional mechanisms (Mace and Therien 1996).

👉 በታዋቂው የፖለቲካ ሳይንሰኛ ጆሴፍ ናይ (Joseph Nye) አገላለጽ፣ ቀጠና ማለት በጂኦግራፊያዊ ወሰን የተያያዙ እና የእርስ በእርስ ጥገኝነት (Mutual Interdependence) ያላቸው የተወሰኑ ሀገራት ስብስብ ነው። በጂኦግራፊ ብቻ መገናኘት በቂ አይደለም፤ የኢኮኖሚ ወይም የፖለቲካ ትስስር ሊኖራቸው ይገባል።

👉 ሪጅናሊዝም (Regionalism) በሁለት መንገድ ይገነባል፦
1. 'From below' (ከስር የሚነሳ)፦ በንግድ፣ በኢንቨስትመንት እና በሰዎች እንቅስቃሴ የሚፈጠር ተፈጥሯዊ ትስስር።
2. 'From above' (ከላይ የሚመጣ)፦ በመንግስታት የፖለቲካ ውሳኔ፣ ስምምነት እና ህግጋት የሚመሰረት ትብብር።

👉 የባሪ ቡዛን (Buzan et al., 1998) የደረጃዎች ክፍፍል፦
• Societal Context: ብሔሮችን (Nations) መሰረት ያደረገ ማህበራዊ ስብስብ።
• Political Context: ሀገር-መንግስታትን (States) መሰረት ያደረገ ፖለቲካዊ ግዛት።
• Sub-region (ንዑስ ቀጠና)፦ ከአንድ ትልቅ ቀጠና ውስጥ ያሉ የተወሰኑ ሀገራት ስብስብ (ምሳሌ፦ በምስራቅ አፍሪካ/East Africa ቀጠና ስር ያለዉ የኢትዮጵያ፣ ኤርትራ፣ ጅቡቲና ሶማሊያ የቋንጣ አፍ / Horn of Africa ስብስብ)።
• Micro-region፦ በአንድ ሀገር ድንበር ውስጥ ያለ ንዑስ የኢኮኖሚ ወይም የባህል ቀጠና።

👉 ሪጅናላይዜሽን vs ሪጅናሊዝም (በጣም ወሳኝ!)፦
• Regionalization (ኢ-መደበኛ ሂደት)፦ በህዝቦች፣ በነጋዴዎችና ኩባንያዎች መካከል የሚደረግ ድንገተኛና ተፈጥሯዊ የኢኮኖሚና ማህበራዊ ግንኙነት እድገት ነው።
• Regionalism (መደበኛ ፖሊሲ)፦ የመንግስታት ፖለቲካዊ ፍላጎትና ውሳኔ ሆኖ፣ ሀብትንና ስልጣንን በማጣመር የጋራ ተቋማትን የመመስረት ሂደት ነው።

😅 EthioFresh Humor Break: የ Micro-region እና Sub-region ልዩነት ግራ ከገባህ፤ ዶርማችሁ Micro-region ነው፣ መሉ ብሎኩ Sub-region ነው፣ ጠቅላላ ግቢው ደግሞ Region ነው! በዶርም አባላት መካከል ያለው የመረዳዳት Interdependence ደግሞ ከ Regional Integration በምንም አይለይም! 😂
💡 Exam Hint: ፈተና ላይ Regionalism vs Regionalization ልዩነት በግዴታ ይመጣል። Regionalism ይበልጥ State-led (የመንግስታት ፖሊሲና ውሳኔ) ሲሆን፣ Regionalization ደግሞ Process-led/Societal integration (የንግድ፣ የሰዎችና ማህበረሰባዊ ግንኙነት እድገት) ነው። እንዲሁም የ Joseph Nye የ Region ትርጉም (Geographical relationship + Mutual Interdependence) ለ Matching ጥያቄ ተወዳጅ ነው!

4.6.1. The Old Regionalism

Theoretical Roots, European Model & Developing World Dynamics

1. Emergence and Nature of Old Regionalism:
Old regionalism is predominantly a post-World War II phenomenon that originated in Western Europe in the late 1940s and subsequently spread to the developing world. By the early 1970s, it lost much of its initial dynamism both in Europe and developing regions.

2. Regional Integration in Europe (The European Model):
Old regionalism in Europe was rooted in the devastating experience of inter-war nationalism and World War II. Post-war European scholars viewed the Westphalian nation-state as the primary cause of conflict rather than the solution. Consequently, the goal of integration was peace, stability, reconstruction, and historical reconciliation between France and Germany.

  • ECSC (1951): European Coal and Steel Community was launched to integrate heavy industries vital for warfare.
  • EEC & EAEC (1958): Created through the Treaty of Rome (1957), integrating the European Economic Community and European Atomic Energy Community into the European Communities (EC).
  • Eurocentric Bias: As Breslin et al. (2002) observed, Western scholars used Europe as an absolute 'model' for regional integration worldwide, leading to misinterpretations when applied to non-Western contexts.

3. Regional Integration in Africa and the Developing World (Structuralist Approach):
In sharp contrast to the European focus on peace and supranational integration, regionalism in Latin America, Africa, and Asia was tied to anti-colonialism, state sovereignty, nation-building, and economic development.

  • Structuralist Economic Theory: Influenced by Gunnar Myrdal, Arthur Lewis, and Raúl Prebisch (UN Economic Commission for Latin America - ECLA).
  • Import Substitution Industrialization (ISI): Developing nations adopted ISI and regional protectionism to create enlarged regional economic spaces, achieving economies of scale while protecting infant domestic industries from Western dominance (Prebisch 1959).
  • Latin America (LAFTA): The Latin American Free Trade Association (1960) failed to achieve significant economic impact due to political instability, interstate conflicts, and military dictatorships.
  • African Experience: African regionalism was shaped by the ideological clash between the Casablanca Group (radical federalists advocating immediate political unification led by Kwame Nkrumah) and the Monrovia Group (moderate gradualists favoring incremental sovereign cooperation).
    • Founding Instruments: OAU Charter (1963/64), Lagos Plan of Action (1980), and Abuja Treaty (1991).
    • State-led Organizations: CFA (Community of French Africa), EAC (East African Community), SACU (Southern African Customs Union), and SADCC (Southern Africa Development Coordination Conference), which was specifically created to resist the influence of Apartheid South Africa and reduce external economic dependency.

👉 የአሮጌው ሪጅናሊዝም (Old Regionalism) መነሻ፦ ከሁለተኛው የዓለም ጦርነት ማብቃት በኋላ በ1940ዎቹ አጋማሽ በምዕራብ አውሮፓ ተጀመረ።

👉 የአውሮፓ ሞዴል (European Context)፦
• አውሮፓውያን የዓለም ጦርነት ውድመትን ካዩ በኋላ፣ ብሔራዊ መንግስታት (Nation-states) ለጦርነት መንስኤ ናቸው ብለው ስለታመኑ፣ ሰላምንና መረጋጋትን ለማስፈን ተቀናቃኞቹን ፈረንሳይንና ጀርመንን ማስታረቅ አስፈላጊ ሆነ።
• በ 1951 ECSC፣ በ 1958 ደግሞ በ Treaty of Rome አማካኝነት EEC እና EAEC ተመሰረቱ።
• Eurocentric Bias: ምዕራባውያን ተመራማሪዎች የአውሮፓን ተሞክሮ እንደ ብቸኛ የዓለም ሞዴል (Universal Model) አድርገው ወስደውት ነበር።

👉 የአፍሪካና ታዳጊ ሀገራት ሞዴል (Developing World Context)፦
• በአፍሪካና ላቲን አሜሪካ የሪጅናሊዝም አላማ ከአውሮፓ ፈጹም የተለየ ነበር። አላማው የኢኮኖሚ እድገት (Development)፣ ከቅኝ ግዛት ነፃ መውጣት (Anti-colonialism) እና ሀገር የመገንባት ሂደት (Nation-building) ነበር።
• Import Substitution Industrialization (ISI)፦ በራኡል ፕሬቢሽ (Raúl Prebisch) የሚመራው የስትራክቸራሊስት አስተሳሰብ፣ ሀገራት የውጭ ምርቶችን በመግታት የራሳቸውን የውስጥ ኢንዱስትሪ በቀጠና ደረጃ ለማሳደግ የክልል ጥበቃ (Regional Protectionism) እንዲጠቀሙ አሳሰበ።
• በአፍሪካ የነበረው የጎራ ክርክር፦ በ Casablanca Group (በኳሜ ንክሩማህ የሚመራ፣ ፈጣን የፖለቲካ አንድነት/United States of Africa የሚፈልግ) እና በ Monrovia Group (ደረጃ በደረጃ የኢኮኖሚ ትብብር የሚፈልግ) መካከል የነበረው ክርክር የአፍሪካ አንድነት ድርጅት (OAU) መመስረት ላይ ትልቅ ተፅዕኖ ነበረው።
• SADCC፦ በደቡብ አፍሪካ የነበረውን የነጭ ዘረኛ አስተዳደር (Apartheid) እና የውጭ ጥገኝነትን ለመቋቋም የተቋቋመ ድርጅት ነበር።

😅 EthioFresh Humor Break: በ Casablanca እና Monrovia ግሩፕ መካከል ያለው ክርክር፤ ከግቢ ካፌ "ምግብ አሁን ይቅረብልን" እና "አይ በደንብ ተሰራርቶ በሒደት ይምጣ" እንደሚባለው አይነት ነው! መጨረሻ ላይ Monrovia ግሩፕ አሸንፎ OAU ደረጃ በደረጃ ተመሰረተ! 😁
💡 Exam Hint: በፈተና ላይ፦
1. ለአውሮፓ Old Regionalism ዋና ግብ Peace & Security / Reconciliation ሲሆን፣ ለታዳጊ ሀገራት (Africa & Latin America) ግን Development, Sovereignty & Import Substitution (ISI) ነበር።
2. SADCC የተቋቋመበት ዋና ምክንያት Apartheid South Africa ን ለመቋቋም ነው።
3. Treaty of Rome (1958) EEC እና EAECን መሥረተ። እነዚህን በ Matching እንዳታሳስቱ!

4.6.2. The New Regionalism

Theoretical Dynamics & Multi-Dimensional Features

1. Context and Drivers of New Regionalism:
The new wave of regionalism emerged in the late 1980s and 1990s, triggered by the fall of the Berlin Wall, the end of Cold War bipolarity, the 1985 White Paper on the Internal Market, and the Single European Act. Structural drivers include:

  • End of superpower bipolarity and Cold War rivalries.
  • Intensification of economic and technological globalization.
  • Recurrent fears over the stability of the multilateral trading order (GATT/WTO).
  • Restructuring of the nation-state and critique of neoliberal economic development models.

2. Core Characteristics of New Regionalism:

  • Open Regionalism: Externally oriented and non-protectionist, designed to integrate regions into the global economy rather than walling them off.
  • Anti-Hegemonic Growth: Created spontaneously from within regions rather than being engineered or dominated by Cold War superpowers.
  • Multi-Dimensional & Pluralistic: Expands beyond mere trade or military security to cover environmental governance, human rights, democracy, security, and culture.
  • Involvement of Non-State Actors: Active participation of multinational corporations (MNCs), civil society organizations, NGOs, and informal networks alongside state actors.
  • Varied Institutional Design: Combines formal and informal, hard and soft regional frameworks.

Comparative Framework: Old vs. New Regionalism (Table 1 - Söderbaum, 2015)

DimensionOld RegionalismNew Regionalism
World Order ContextCold War / Bipolar world order contextPost-Cold War / Multipolar world order context
Links (National, Regional, Global)Taming nationalism (in Europe) or Advancing nationalism (in South)Resisting, taming or advancing economic globalization
Sectors, Actors & FormsSector-specific, State-centric, Formal, Hard regionalismMulti-sectoral, State vs. non-state actors, Regionalism vs. regionalization, Formal vs. informal, Hard vs. soft
OntologyRegional integration, Regional organizations (& subsystems), Clear boundary linesOntological pluralism, confusion and disagreement, Regionalism, Regionalization, Regional organizations
EpistemologyDominance of positivism, rationalism & materialism (structuralism in South)Rationalism vs. constructivism vs. critical theory, Materialism vs. ideas/identities conflict
MethodologyEurope-focused, Rigid comparisonRegional specialization vs. false universalism (Eurocentrism), Parallel case studies / Quantitative studies

👉 የአዲሱ ሪጅናሊዝም (New Regionalism) መፈጠር፦ የቀዝቃዛው ጦርነት ማብቃት (Berlin Wall መፍረስ)፣ የግሎባላይዜሽን መንሰራፋት እና የመልቲፖላር (Multipolar) ዓለም መፈጠር አዲሱን ሪጅናሊዝም ወለደ።

👉 የአዲሱ ሪጅናሊዝም ዋና ዋና ባህሪያት፦
1. Open Regionalism (ክፍት ሪጅናሊዝም)፦ እንደ አሮጌው ጥብቅ ጥበቃ (Protectionism) ሳይሆን ከዓለም አቀፍ ገበያ ጋር የተሳሰረ ነው።
2. Anti-hegemonic፦ በልዕለ-ኃያላን አሜሪካና ሶቪየት ህብረት የሚደወር ሳይሆን ከቀጠናው ሀገራት ውስጣዊ ፍላጎት የሚመነጭ ነው።
3. Multi-dimensional፦ በንግድና ደህንነት ብቻ ሳይሆን በአካባቢ ጥበቃ፣ ሰብአዊ መብት፣ ዲሞክራሲና ባህል ላይ ያተኩራል።
4. Non-state Actors፦ መንግስታት ብቻ ሳይሆኑ ኤንጂኦዎች፣ የግል ኩባንያዎችና ሲቪል ማህበራት ይሳተፉበታል።

👉 የወቅቱ አፍሪካና የኢትዮጵያ አውድ፦ በምስራቅና ደቡብ አፍሪካ የሚገኙት IGAD፣ COMESA፣ EAC እና አህጉራዊው AfCFTA (African Continental Free Trade Area) የአዲሱ ሪጅናሊዝም ህያው ማሳያዎች ናቸው። ኢትዮጵያም በቀጠናዊ የኃይል፣ የመንገድና የንግድ ትስስር ንቁ ተሳታፊ الناት።
